description: When the traveller asks for a receipt, an invoice or proof of a booking: Vuelo emails it to the email on the booking (never to an address you give), with what was booked, the dates, and the money as it stands: paid, reserved with the date it is due, on a payment plan, or cancelled with its refund. You do not see the receipt. Pass the Vuelo reference (VU-...) and the email or mobile it was booked with, or the taskId of a booking made in this conversation. If the booking has no email, it says so: then use contact_support.

email.description: The email the traveller booked with.

mobile.description: Or the mobile on the booking.

taskId.description: The booking's taskId, if it was made in this conversation.

name: send_receipt
title: Email the traveller their receipt
